referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Raw materials, average transport to Switzerland, emissions to air from tank storage, estimation for storage infrastructure.
referenceFunction.name: Methanol, at regional storage

geography.text: Data for distances from production places to Switzerland estimated with actual plant capacityes. Data for import releated to whole Europe. Imports data for Europe applied for Switzerland. Similar overseas distances assumed.

technology.text: Assumed that 40% of the methanol origins from overseas. Additional 13% from Noway also including tanker transport. Other production within continetal Europe.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Representativity of the assumed transport distances and the used modal split was not determined.
